patches.summary: Hand-built 8 novel commands (~600 LOC) registered alongside the absorbed surface: dns apply, redirect set, propagate watch, where-is, zones diff, worker bindings show, cache purge release, setup_zone.
patches.reason: Phase 3 transcendence layer — these are the agent-introspection / cross-product / idempotent-infra commands that justify the CLI's existence beyond the absorbed REST surface. None are derivable from the OpenAPI spec.
patches.validated_outcome: All 8 transcendence commands callable. Full DNS CRUD lifecycle (create / no-op / update / delete / verify-gone via where-is) verified live on a real Cloudflare account; setup_zone, propagate watch, zones diff, where-is, cache purge release verified against real zones.

patches.summary: Switched generator's auth-scheme preference from legacy email+key to API token (Bearer). config.go now emits Authorization: Bearer header when CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN is set; falls back to legacy CLOUDFLARE_API_EMAIL + CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY.
patches.reason: Cloudflare's OpenAPI declares both schemes; generator picked legacy. Modern Cloudflare guidance prefers scoped API tokens. SKILL Phase 2 'safety net' pattern for multi-scheme APIs.
patches.validated_outcome: doctor reports auth_source: env:CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN; live API calls succeed; legacy fallback functional.

patches.summary: Trimmed auto-generated endpoint-mirror surface from ~3,000 to ~390 commands by deleting internal/cli/*.go files for long-tail products. Kept: DNS, Workers (KV/D1/R2/Pages), Zones + Settings, Cache, Page Rules, Rulesets, SSL/TLS, Origin TLS, IAM, API Tokens, Members, Registrar, Certificates. Dropped: Stream, Images, Magic Transit/WAN, Zero Trust, Vectorize, Workers AI, DEX, Healthchecks, Logpush, Audit Logs, Notifications, Load Balancers, Spectrum, plus account-level long-tail.
patches.reason: PR #352 (predecessor) was closed for size — 3,130 files was too large for one review bite. Empirical research (Wrangler + flarectl + terraform-provider + cloudflare-go signals) ranked Cloudflare API products by real developer usage. Long-tail deferred to follow-up PRs once v1 lands.
patches.validated_outcome: go build ./... clean; go vet ./... clean; full smoke-test surface functional. 519 files (84% smaller than #352).

patches.summary: Updated go.mod module path from `module cloudflare-pp-cli` to `module github.com/mvanhorn/printing-press-library/library/cloud/cloudflare`. Updated 13 internal Go files' import statements to match.
patches.reason: verify-library-conventions check #3 requires module path to match directory location; without it, `go install …@latest` breaks downstream after publication.
patches.validated_outcome: go build ./... clean from new module path; verify-library-conventions check #3 satisfied.

patches.summary: Updated manifest.json mcp_config.env + user_config to reference CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN (Bearer) rather than CLOUDFLARE_API_EMAIL (legacy). Bumped .printing-press.json auth_type from 'api_key' to 'bearer_token' and auth_env_vars to ['CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN'].
patches.reason: Companion to auth-scheme-bearer-preferred — manifest values must match binary's actual auth preference, otherwise .mcpb installer prompts users for the wrong env var.
patches.validated_outcome: Validate MCPB manifest contract CI check passes; .mcpb installer prompts user for CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.
